summary_en: Introduces RSFusionDet and the paired RSFusion RGB-sonar dataset for underwater multimodal object detection. The framework uses cross-attention to fuse spatially misaligned RGB and sonar features and adds an explicit object-matching head/loss to associate the same targets across modalities, jointly evaluating per-modality detection and cross-modal correspondence.
